Package net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.services

Class SSLContexts

java.lang.Object
net.ygbstudio.powerwp4j.services.SSLContexts
public class SSLContexts extends Object
Factory for SSLContext instances used by the WordPress client.

Provides helpers for default, custom trust-manager, and trust-store configurations.
